scenario.scenario_text: You are working on a group project with three other students. One member of your group has not responded to messages or attended meetings for two weeks. The project deadline is next week. Your group leader sent you an email asking for your opinion on what to do.
requirements: Share your opinion about the situation
Suggest at least one specific action the group should take
Offer to help with extra work if needed

coach_content.step1_situation_ar: أنت ضمن مجموعة من أربعة طلاب تعملون على مشروع جامعي. أحد أعضاء المجموعة اختفى لمدة أسبوعين (لم يرد على رسائل ولم يحضر اجتماعات). الموعد النهائي بعد أسبوع. قائد المجموعة (زميلك) أرسل لك إيميل يسأل رأيك. مهمتك: ترد بإيميل ودي لكنه احترافي يحقق ثلاثة أهداف.
coach_content.step1_situation_en: You are in a 4-student group project. One member has been missing for 2 weeks. Deadline next week. The group leader asks for your opinion.
coach_content.step1_recipient_ar: زميل في الدراسة (قائد مجموعة). شخص في نفس مستواك لكن في موقع مسؤولية. النبرة ودية لكن جدية.
coach_content.step1_tone_ar: ودية احترافية (Friendly Professional). أقل رسمية من الأستاذ لكنها واضحة ومنظمة.

step1_goals_json.ar: اقترح خطوة عملية واحدة على الأقل

coach_content.step4_model_email:
Hi Sarah,

Thank you for reaching out about the group situation. I have been thinking about this issue as well, and I am glad we can discuss it together before the deadline.

In my opinion, we should give him one final chance by sending a clear message explaining the urgency of the deadline. If he does not respond within 24 hours, I suggest that we redistribute his tasks among the remaining three members and inform Professor Anderson about what happened.

I am willing to take on additional work to make sure we submit a high-quality project on time. Specifically, I can handle the data analysis section that he was responsible for.

Please let me know what you think, and I am ready to start as soon as we agree on a plan.

Best,
Ahmad
